content:
jules_cs: Quick flag on Orion renewal — they want a 12mo renewal but split payment methods: ACH for the subscription (Orion US) and CC for the onboarding fee (Orion EU). Procurement asked for a notarized signature on the EU SOW annex. Can we support ACH + card + notarization?

omar_sales: They've committed on price if we accept their payment mix. PO will come but procurement said notarization is their compliance requirement for the EU entity's SOW annex. PO ETA 4 business days.

kelly_fin: Finance can accept ACH for the subscription and a one-time CC for onboarding. For ACH we need bank remit details + vendor onboarding ID and a W-9 for US entity or W-8 if non-US. For EU entity we need VAT and a contact. Please capture: 
```
US entity: bank_account_mask, vendor_id, W-9_present (yes/no)
EU entity: VAT, billing_contact, notarization_required (yes)
PO_number: TBD
```

yvonne_legal: Notarization is heavier than e-witness. We can produce a Notarized Addendum: options are (A) Customer obtains local notary and returns notarized PDF, or (B) we arrange a remote online notarization provider if jurisdiction permits. Which does procurement prefer? @omar_sales can you check?

jules_cs: Pinged buyer: "We can support ACH + CC and a Notarized Addendum. Do you want to provide a notarized PDF or use remote online notarization? Also please share vendor IDs, bank remit for ACH, VAT, and PO ETA."

esign-bot: Template search: found "Renewal-ACH-CC-Notary-Addendum". Can generate DocuSign envelope with attachments field for notarized PDF and optional remote-notary step. Reply `create envelope` to proceed.

omar_sales: Buyer prefers us to handle remote notarization if available. They said PO will be in ~3 business days and bank remit + vendor ID attached in email. CC for on-boarding is fine to charge after signature.

kelly_fin: Finance ok with charging CC after signature. For ACH we will wait until remittance + vendor onboarding completes and PO is recorded. Set invoice terms Net45 after PO. Also require procurement email captured on envelope.

yvonne_legal: I'll draft Notarized Addendum language (short): 
```
Notarized Addendum: For the EU legal entity, the parties agree that the SOW Annex will be executed with a notarized signature. Execution may be via (i) customer-provided notarized PDF, or (ii) remote online notarization facilitated by Vendor (if legally permitted). Notary name, country, and timestamp must be recorded in the signing audit trail.
```
Include a fallback clause: if notarization not completed within 7 business days, parties will revert to e-witness and schedule remediation.

jules_cs: Sounds good. Plan: 1) use `Renewal-ACH-CC-Notary-Addendum` template, attach vendor remit, PO:TBD, provenance fields; 2) route remote-notary step if buyer picks that; 3) charge CC after signature; 4) finalize ACH once bank details and PO are on file. Proceeding unless objections.

esign-bot: Ready to create envelope with remote notary option and attachment slot. Reply `create envelope` to start.

omar_sales: Proceed. I'll follow up to confirm remote notary provider and get procurement contact.

kelly_fin: Finance note: add invoice metadata tag `notarization: pending` and `po: TBD` so accounting flags the record.

jules_cs: Done — creating envelope now and will paste link. Will update when signed or when PO/bank remit lands. :white_check_mark:
